edges.label: Anomalous phenomena inside a defence contract
edges.note: The AAWSAP statement of work and its deliverables are the tier-1 basis for treating this material as a programme domain rather than folklore.

edges.label: Field physics is the propulsion answer
edges.note: DIRD 15 and DIRD 19 are commissioned studies of metric engineering and antigravity - the exotic-physics domain applied to the flight problem.

edges.label: Tasking reveals expectation
edges.note: The AAWSAP statement of work and the thirty-eight DIRDs are the tier-1 evidence that a government agency paid for study of the physics a recovered craft would require.

edges.label: Same investigators, later contract
edges.note: Principal investigators from the SRI-era programmes reappear in the AAWSAP deliverables three decades later, carrying the research framing with them.
